## Try It Out!
### Auto-approve Sharetribe users based on user type

Automatically approve users of a specific type (e.g., buyers) while requiring manual approval for others (e.g., providers). This streamlines onboarding for low-risk user types while maintaining quality control.

### How it works
* The Sharetribe Trigger polls for `user/created` events with the full user resource.
* An IF node checks the user's type from their publicData (set during registration).
* If the user type matches, the Sharetribe Approve User action sets their state to active.

### How to set up
1. Connect your Sharetribe credentials (Client ID and Client Secret from Console > Build > Applications).
2. Enable "Require user approval" in Console > Build > General.
3. Update the IF node's comparison value to match your target user type ID from Console > Build > Users > User types.
4. Activate the workflow.

### Requirements
* Sharetribe marketplace with Integration API credentials
* User approval enabled in marketplace settings
* User types configured in Console

### How to customize
* Add multiple IF conditions to approve several user types.
* Add a Gmail node to notify approved users.
* Chain with an Update Permissions node to grant specific rights based on user type.
* Add the false branch to send a "pending review" notification.

Need help? Visit the [n8n Community](https://community.n8n.io/) or [Sharetribe Docs](https://www.sharetribe.com/docs/).

## 1. Listen for new users
Polls for `user/created` events with the full resource to access the user's publicData including their user type.

## 2. Check user type
Compares the user's publicData.userType against the target type ID. Update the value to match your user type from Console > Build > Users > User types.

## 3. Approve the user
Sets the user's state from `pendingApproval` to `active`, granting them full marketplace access.
